facts.fact: Antibiotics treat bacterial infections, not viral infections.
The Earth orbits the Sun, completing one revolution per year.
Sound requires a material medium and cannot propagate through a vacuum.
Carbon forms four covalent bonds in stable compounds.
In a vacuum, all objects fall at the same rate regardless of mass.
Insulin lowers blood glucose; glucagon raises it.
Photosynthesis consumes carbon dioxide and releases oxygen.
Energy cannot be created or destroyed, only transformed.
No heat engine can exceed 100 percent efficiency.
Mitochondrial DNA is inherited almost exclusively through the maternal line.
Ice is less dense than liquid water, which is why ice floats.
Metals are good electrical conductors; plastics are insulators.
Gravity is the weakest of the four fundamental forces.
Vaccines train the immune system without causing the disease they prevent.
Water is composed of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
